technical.summary: Strong uptrend with extreme overbought conditions and ADX confirmation, but momentum indicators show exhaustion risk and lack of fresh entry signals—suitable for continuation trades only with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: AIG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 76 days—insufficient smart money alignment for quantitative trade initiation.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional; market fear (42 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and weak political conviction limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (234), imminent NFP event, and financial sector credit vulnerability create severe headwinds for AIG despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend confirmation with price above all major moving averages and RSI extreme overbought (91.97) suggests powerful momentum continuation if breakout holds above 59.1964 resistance.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 234, credit spread crisis), zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, no smart money alignment), momentum exhaustion signals (RSI falling, no fresh entry triggers), and financial sector vulnerability create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows strong ADX trend with price above all major moving averages, but this is negated by extreme overbought conditions (RSI 91.97, Stoch 93.04) signaling exhaustion without fresh entry triggers.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment is in crisis mode (VIX 234, inverted yield curve, credit spreads elevated) with financial sector under severe stress; AIG earnings in 76 days adds event risk to an already vulnerable position.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AIG with 116 open Financials positions (28% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing exposure reduce conviction further; avoid adding to concentrated risk.
